subject: hi-p
title: HI.P.------(R)INTR.
description: Chart on book p. 239 (T(IMP)M-37). HI-P (high purpose) is the subject; INTR (interpretation) is the partner, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From the subject: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and TR (transformation). From SOC-RT-DY: INFO-TRNS (information transference). From SPT-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: SF-RZ (self-realization). From SF-RZ: MOT-DY. From TR: C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: C-CONT (composite continuance).
